items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I told Jeff and Bubby and Nina, all of them together. [INTERVIEWEE] Good.

ctx.x: Didn't have to change a thing, it happened this way, my grandfather played all stringed instruments, you see, and when I, when this fella loaned me this bass, my grandfather came over to try to show me how to tune it, and being right-hand never occurred to him to show me, you know, he was an old gentleman at the time, and he didn't think about telling me to change the strings back, he just tuned it up and said, here it is. I just took it that way and started picking on it, see, put on a phonograph record, and I…
I told Jeff and Bubby and Nina, all of them together.
